acceptanceCriteria: Recognize structurally valid known-safe Go JSON verbose PASS event markers without admitting credentials in arbitrary JSON values or test names.
Retain existing plain PASS exemption and all secret assignment/vendor/escaped content protections; no global regex or screening bypass.
Actual dogfood verify of unchanged go test -json command produces qualified PASS on clean bound target, while credential-bearing JSON output stays screened and unqualified.
Retain meaningful failing-before/passing-after evidence, focused checks and independent security review; preserve original frozen plan and prior failed receipts.
body: Observed during V1-0541 final original complete-attempts check at clean e5d777cbd1202dbffb88ce114956b304035bd5c5, workflowBASE2a10/key4969/plan9493. Actual raw keyed output is intentionally not retained by recorder, so exact triggering raw match there cannot be recovered; independent source discriminator and previous actual unit JSON establish confirmed safe JSON false positive. title: Dogfood verify secret screen rejects Go JSON PASS output as a credential assignment
